verdict.rationale: Yapily publishes a per-endpoint API reference (accounts, transactions, authorisations, authentication), provides an OpenAPI v3 spec for code generation, and offers a sandbox for testing against test banks. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI file at the standard public paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
